beginner.name: Beginner: Adding within 5
beginner.activityPages: Final count coming with the finished file
beginner.supportingPages: Final count coming with the finished file
beginner.skills: Count two groups, put them together, and write the total. Totals stay at 5 or below. A short addition story is included.
beginner.prerequisites: A good start if your child can count to 10, read numbers 0–5, and count objects one by one.
beginner.shipping: Digital download. No physical item will be shipped.
beginner.materials: A printer, paper, a pencil, and small counters such as buttons or cereal.
beginner.license: Print for your own children, your homeschool, or a single classroom.
beginner.delivery: After you pay, Payhip shows a download page and emails a receipt from contact@payhip.com. Each link allows 10 downloads.
beginner.help: Email hello@proudlittlelearners.com. We reply within 1 business day.
